engineeringSkip.reason: Nuclear pasta exists only inside neutron-star crusts under gravitational pressures impossible to reproduce or contain in a laboratory, so 'nuclear pasta-steel' is not an engineerable material.

factCheck.reason: 'Nuclear pasta' exists only inside neutron stars at densities around a hundred trillion times that of steel, and no press on Earth can create or hold degenerate matter, so a room-temperature 'nuclear pasta-steel' with near-infinite strength cannot be made.
